combo_label: Weather & Seasons × Musical Instruments × Samurai & Feudal Japan

entries.clue: Poem of seventeen syllables, anchored by a single word naming the season
Break in the freeze that reduces the snowman to a stump — or in icy relations.
Tall triangular frame of strings plucked by both hands, pedals below
The dark quarter of the year, when ponds harden and days shrink.
Flat Alpine soundboard, many taut strings, laid on a table and plucked
Named Atlantic monster with a calm eye and coast-wrecking winds.
Curved single-edged blade worn slung with its cutting edge upward
Glossy tree-sap finish built up in thin layers on bowls, boxes and armour
Member of the hereditary warrior caste, entitled to a surname and two blades
Drifting raft of water droplets that decides whether the picnic goes ahead.
Deep-voiced strings gripped between the knees and sung by a horsehair bow
Shimmering curtain of colour over polar skies on long dark nights.
Wide waist sash tied in an elaborate knot behind
Black cylinder of woodwind, flared at the bell, warm and woody down low
